relevance_note: Case report of one Saudi boy with chronic ITP and vitiligo in whom WES 'identified the heterozygous variant c.1420A>G (p.Thr474Ala) in exon7 of the TNFAIP3 gene'.
method_note: Read the full paper manually; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans (no table transcription; the paper has no tables). One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (label rule 5). The eight siblings ('none of whom have any significant medical history') and the non-consanguineous parents were neither tested nor affected, so they get no rows. Zhou et al. [13] patients are mentioned only at group level (counts) and Shin et al. [14] patient has no stated TNFAIP3 variant, so neither gets rows. Age: the patient 'presented for the first time in April 2017' at 12 years (to the authors' centre), while the Discussion says he 'was nine years old at the time of the first presentation' and he was diagnosed with ITP at 9; onset recorded from the 'first presentation' phrase, diagnosis from 'diagnosed with ITP at the age of 9 years'. Age at last evaluation left 'not reported' because follow-up extends to at least late 2019 ('Currently...') and no age is given for it; '12-year-old' refers to April 2017. Contradictions: (1) the Case presentation reports 'a history of mild epistaxis' and 'multiple hospitalizations due to recurrent epistaxis and ecchymosis', whereas the Discussion says 'Our patient did not report any history of bleeding in the past' and 'no bleeding was observed in our patient'; both rows emitted (epistaxis/ecchymosis observed, bleeding excluded); no checklist item covers bleeding. (2) The Abstract says he 'did not respond to rituximab or eltrombopag' while the text reports a platelet rise to 457 x 10^9 cells/L on eltrombopag 75 mg followed by loss of response (treatment response only, not a phenotype). Gene symbol misspelled once as 'TNFAJP3' in the Discussion; recorded TNFAIP3 as printed in the variant sentence. In silico predictions ('10 of 16 bioinformatics in silico programs predict a pathogenic') are not a functional assay, so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'. variant_type 'missense' is from the authors' wording 'leads to an amino acid exchange'. Not used for exclusions: 'Our case did not report any such features' after the list of Zhou et al. features, because its scope is ambiguous (it follows a sentence about ulcers, and the patient did have thrombocytopenia, which was in that list). Checklist judgements: 'skin lesions' observed on the basis of vitiligo (depigmented patches); 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' observed on the basis of immune thrombocytopenia; 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation' excluded from ophthalmology consultation with 'no significant findings'; 'arthritis or arthralgia' excluded from 'no history of ... joint involvement' plus normal musculoskeletal examination; 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy' excluded from 'no organomegaly or lymphadenopathy' plus normal double-negative T cells. Negative direct agglutinin test does not exclude the broader 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)' item, left 'not reported'. cohort_size_as_stated left null (case report, no cohort size stated); cites_prior_report false, supported by the authors' 'first Saudi child' statement.
